selection_reasoning: These 4 tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence centered around building and decorating a home. The player must first locate gold_ore (exploration/navigation task), mine sandstone (resource gathering), craft oak_stairs (crafting task requiring wood resources), and finally decorate the home using the gathered materials and crafted items. The gold_ore serves as a decorative/structural element, sandstone provides building material, and oak_stairs are a common decorative element in homes. The final 'decorate the home' task depends on having completed the resource gathering and crafting steps.

edges.reason: Gold ore blocks found during exploration are used as decorative accent blocks in the home
Mined sandstone provides building material for home decoration elements like walls or flooring
Crafted oak stairs are placed inside the home as furniture (chairs, shelving, roof detail)

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the gold ore deposit (NW of spawn at [-6, 0, -6]) and face it to visually confirm discovery. Gold ore cannot be mined with the provided wooden pickaxe, so only proximity+facing is checked.

Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone with any pickaxe (wooden included) drops the sandstone block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 sandstone, so any sandstone in inventory confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because crafting oak_stairs (6 oak planks → 4 oak stairs) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 oak_stairs, so having 4 confirms successful crafting of at least one batch.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because 'decorate the home' is a place/build task. We verify that at least 1 oak_stairs block has been placed inside the house interior (box [4,1,4] to [8,4,8] covers the 5x5x4 interior air space). This confirms the player used crafted materials to furnish the home. Only oak_stairs is checked since it's the crafted decorative item from a prior task.

scene_description: An open clearing with a pre-built oak plank house (7x7 interior) to the east of spawn, a gold ore deposit to the northwest, and a sandstone deposit to the southwest. The player spawns in the center with oak planks, a wooden pickaxe, and a crafting table in inventory. The house has a door opening on the front (south) wall and a window on the back (north) wall, with a crafting table already inside. The scene supports: finding gold_ore (NW deposit), mining sandstone (SW deposit with pickaxe), crafting oak_stairs (using crafting table + oak planks), and decorating the home (placing gathered/crafted materials inside).
task_text: Find the gold ore deposit, mine sandstone blocks, craft oak stairs using the crafting table, then decorate the nearby house using the materials you've gathered and crafted.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin (0,0,0). House is at +3 to +9 on X and Z axes (east/southeast). Gold ore cluster at -6,-6 (northwest, 4 blocks in 2x2 column). Sandstone deposit at -7 to -5 on X, 5 to 8 on Z (southwest, 3x4x2 = 24 blocks). House has 3-wide door on south wall (Z=3) and 1-wide window on north wall (Z=9). Crafting table inside house at (6,1,5). Player given 16 oak planks for crafting stairs (need 6 for 4 stairs), wooden pickaxe for mining, and spare crafting table. Air fill clears natural trees for visibility.
